Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 110. Category: feat. Saiyan Feats.

Requires: Beyond SSGSS and Super Saiyan 3
You have the ability to use Super Saiyan 3 and Super
Saiyan God as a Combination Transformation. This
Combination Form is known as Super Saiyan God
Super Saiyan 3 or shortened to Super Saiyan Blue 3.
“Kyabeblue”
